One row per team per game: result, runs by inning with first-inning runs for and against, team batting and pitching totals, both starting pitchers, ballpark, weather, attendance and game length. Regular season and postseason are in the same file; spring training, exhibitions and the All-Star game are not included.
:::

## Columns

One row per team per game. 66 columns. A row is identified by `game_pk` + `team_id`.

```{=html}
<div class="store-dict"><table class="table">
<thead><tr>
<th>Column</th>
<th>Type</th>
<th>What it holds</th>
</tr></thead><tbody>
<tr><td>game_pk</td><td>string</td><td>MLB&#x27;s id for the game, the same id MLB.com and Baseball Savant use.</td></tr>
<tr><td>game_date</td><td>date</td><td>Official date of the game; a suspended game keeps the date it started.</td></tr>
<tr><td>season</td><td>int</td><td>Season the game belongs to, as a four-digit year.</td></tr>
<tr><td>season_type</td><td>string</td><td>regular for the regular season, postseason for every playoff round.</td></tr>
<tr><td>game_type</td><td>string</td><td>MLB game type code: R regular season, F wild card round, D division series, L league championship series, W World Series.</td></tr>
<tr><td>game_number</td><td>int</td><td>1 for a single game or the first game of a doubleheader, 2 for the second.</td></tr>
<tr><td>doubleheader</td><td>bool</td><td>True when the game was part of a doubleheader.</td></tr>
<tr><td>team_id</td><td>string</td><td>MLB id of the player&#x27;s or row&#x27;s team.</td></tr>
<tr><td>team</td><td>string</td><td>Team abbreviation as Baseball Savant lists the franchise today (AZ, ATH, CWS, KC, SD, SF, TB, WSH), used for every season.</td></tr>
<tr><td>team_name</td><td>string</td><td>Full team name as it was that season.</td></tr>
<tr><td>opponent_id</td><td>string</td><td>MLB id of the opposing team.</td></tr>
<tr><td>opponent</td><td>string</td><td>Opposing team&#x27;s abbreviation.</td></tr>
<tr><td>opponent_name</td><td>string</td><td>Opposing team&#x27;s full name as it was that season.</td></tr>
<tr><td>home_away</td><td>string</td><td>home when the team was the home team, away when it was the visitor.</td></tr>
<tr><td>result</td><td>string</td><td>W for a win, L for a loss, T for a tie.</td></tr>
<tr><td>runs</td><td>int</td><td>Runs the team scored.</td></tr>
<tr><td>runs_allowed</td><td>int</td><td>Runs the opponent scored.</td></tr>
<tr><td>innings</td><td>int</td><td>Innings played in the game.</td></tr>
<tr><td>runs_inning_1</td><td>int</td><td>Runs the team scored in the first inning.</td></tr>
<tr><td>runs_inning_2</td><td>int</td><td>Runs the team scored in inning 2; blank when the team did not bat in it.</td></tr>
<tr><td>runs_inning_3</td><td>int</td><td>Runs the team scored in inning 3; blank when the team did not bat in it.</td></tr>
<tr><td>runs_inning_4</td><td>int</td><td>Runs the team scored in inning 4; blank when the team did not bat in it.</td></tr>
<tr><td>runs_inning_5</td><td>int</td><td>Runs the team scored in inning 5; blank when the team did not bat in it.</td></tr>
<tr><td>runs_inning_6</td><td>int</td><td>Runs the team scored in inning 6; blank when the team did not bat in it.</td></tr>
<tr><td>runs_inning_7</td><td>int</td><td>Runs the team scored in inning 7; blank when the team did not bat in it.</td></tr>
<tr><td>runs_inning_8</td><td>int</td><td>Runs the team scored in inning 8; blank when the team did not bat in it.</td></tr>
<tr><td>runs_inning_9</td><td>int</td><td>Runs the team scored in inning 9; blank when the team did not bat in it.</td></tr>
<tr><td>runs_inning_10_plus</td><td>int</td><td>Runs the team scored in the tenth inning and later; 0 when the game ended in nine innings or fewer.</td></tr>
<tr><td>first_inning_runs_allowed</td><td>int</td><td>Runs the opponent scored in the first inning.</td></tr>
<tr><td>first_inning_scoreless</td><td>bool</td><td>True when neither team scored in the first inning.</td></tr>
<tr><td>plate_appearances</td><td>int</td><td>Team plate appearances, from the box score.</td></tr>
<tr><td>at_bats</td><td>int</td><td>Team at-bats, from the box score.</td></tr>
<tr><td>hits</td><td>int</td><td>Team hits, counted from the play-by-play outcomes.</td></tr>
<tr><td>doubles</td><td>int</td><td>Team doubles, counted from the play-by-play outcomes.</td></tr>
<tr><td>triples</td><td>int</td><td>Team triples, counted from the play-by-play outcomes.</td></tr>
<tr><td>home_runs</td><td>int</td><td>Team home runs, from the box score.</td></tr>
<tr><td>rbi</td><td>int</td><td>Team runs batted in, from the box score.</td></tr>
<tr><td>walks</td><td>int</td><td>Walks drawn, intentional walks included.</td></tr>
<tr><td>strikeouts</td><td>int</td><td>Times the team&#x27;s batters struck out.</td></tr>
<tr><td>hit_by_pitch</td><td>int</td><td>Times the team&#x27;s batters were hit by a pitch.</td></tr>
<tr><td>stolen_bases</td><td>int</td><td>Team stolen bases, from the box score.</td></tr>
<tr><td>caught_stealing</td><td>int</td><td>Times the team&#x27;s runners were caught stealing, from the box score.</td></tr>
<tr><td>hits_allowed</td><td>int</td><td>Hits by the opponent, counted from the play-by-play outcomes.</td></tr>
<tr><td>home_runs_allowed</td><td>int</td><td>Home runs by the opponent, from the box score.</td></tr>
<tr><td>walks_allowed</td><td>int</td><td>Walks issued by the team&#x27;s pitchers, intentional walks included.</td></tr>
<tr><td>pitching_strikeouts</td><td>int</td><td>Strikeouts by the team&#x27;s pitchers.</td></tr>
<tr><td>pitchers_used</td><td>int</td><td>Number of pitchers the team used.</td></tr>
<tr><td>pitches</td><td>int</td><td>Pitches thrown by the team&#x27;s pitchers; automatic balls and strikes are not pitches.</td></tr>
<tr><td>outs_recorded</td><td>int</td><td>Outs the team&#x27;s pitchers recorded; divide by three for innings pitched.</td></tr>
<tr><td>starter_id</td><td>string</td><td>MLB id of the team&#x27;s starting pitcher, the one who threw its first pitch.</td></tr>
<tr><td>starter_name</td><td>string</td><td>Full name of the team&#x27;s starting pitcher.</td></tr>
<tr><td>starter_throws</td><td>string</td><td>Hand the team&#x27;s starting pitcher throws with: L or R.</td></tr>
<tr><td>opponent_starter_id</td><td>string</td><td>MLB id of the opposing starting pitcher.</td></tr>
<tr><td>opponent_starter_name</td><td>string</td><td>Full name of the opposing starting pitcher.</td></tr>
<tr><td>opponent_starter_throws</td><td>string</td><td>Hand the opposing starting pitcher throws with: L or R.</td></tr>
<tr><td>venue_id</td><td>string</td><td>MLB id of the ballpark.</td></tr>
<tr><td>venue_name</td><td>string</td><td>Name of the ballpark as it was that season.</td></tr>
<tr><td>day_night</td><td>string</td><td>day or night, as MLB classifies the start time.</td></tr>
<tr><td>first_pitch_local</td><td>string</td><td>Actual time of the first pitch on the ballpark&#x27;s local clock, 24-hour HH:MM.</td></tr>
<tr><td>temperature_f</td><td>int</td><td>Temperature at first pitch in degrees Fahrenheit, as announced in the box score.</td></tr>
<tr><td>weather</td><td>string</td><td>Sky condition at first pitch as announced in the box score (Clear, Cloudy, Roof Closed, Dome and so on).</td></tr>
<tr><td>wind_mph</td><td>int</td><td>Wind speed at first pitch in miles per hour, as announced in the box score.</td></tr>
<tr><td>wind_direction</td><td>string</td><td>Wind direction at first pitch relative to the field (Out To CF, In From LF, L To R, Varies and so on); blank when the box score lists none.</td></tr>
<tr><td>attendance</td><td>int</td><td>Announced attendance; blank when none was announced, including the 2020 games played without fans.</td></tr>
<tr><td>duration_minutes</td><td>int</td><td>Length of the game in minutes, not counting delays.</td></tr>
<tr><td>delay_minutes</td><td>int</td><td>Total length of weather or other delays in minutes; blank when there was none.</td></tr>
</tbody></table></div>
```

## Source and method

Scores, runs by inning and the box score totals come from the MLB Stats API (schedule, box scores, linescores, game notes); weather, attendance and game times are the figures announced in the official box score. Hits, doubles, triples, walks, strikeouts and the pitching totals are counted from Baseball Savant Statcast pitch data, and every team total equals the sum of the player game logs. Earned runs, errors and left on base are not included.

The same file layout, IDs and column names are used for every season, so seasons stack without cleanup. See [how the store works](help.qmd) for formats, delivery and the license.

## More MLB data

[Player Game Logs](mlb-player-logs.qmd) · [Play-by-Play](mlb-play-by-play.qmd) · [Games and Results](mlb-schedule.qmd) · [All MLB data](mlb.qmd)

::: {.faq-item}
### How do the MLB files join to each other?

On the ID columns. Game, team and player IDs are the same strings in every MLB file and every season, so a join on `game_id` (plus `team` or `player_id` where the grain needs it) lines them up.
:::

::: {.faq-item}
### Which games are included?

Every regular-season and postseason game, built from the official game feeds and Statcast. Regular season and postseason sit in the same file, told apart by `season_type`. Preseason and All-Star games are left out.
:::
